# Alynne Davis, MA, LCMHC

> Holistic therapy, intensives, and coaching for women in transition. In person in Charlotte, North Carolina, online across North Carolina and South Carolina, and coaching worldwide.

Alynne Davis is a Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor and expressive arts therapist in Charlotte, NC, and the founder of Embodied Reclamation Studio. She works with women who are exhausted from holding everything together and no longer recognize themselves, often through divorce, motherhood, perimenopause, or the end of a relationship.

Her work blends somatic and nervous system practices, creative expression, and deep conversation. It is holistic, meaning it considers sleep, nourishment, movement, relationships, spirituality, self-care, and environment alongside mental health rather than treating a diagnosis in isolation.

## Credentials and scope

- MA, Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor (LCMHC)
- Expressive arts therapist
- Licensed to provide therapy in North Carolina and South Carolina only
- Coaching, which is not therapy, is available to women anywhere
- Not a dietitian or physician. Does not prescribe supplements or meal plans
- Primarily a private-pay practice, superbills available for out-of-network reimbursement

## Specialties

- Eating disorders: binge eating, anorexia, bulimia, orthorexia, emotional eating, chronic dieting
- Body image
- Trauma and complex PTSD
- ADHD in women, including late diagnosis, masking, and burnout
- Anxiety, including high-functioning anxiety
- Perinatal and postpartum mental health
- Life transitions: divorce, motherhood, midlife, perimenopause, identity loss

## Three ways to work with her

- [Therapy](https://alynnedavis.com/services/): ongoing weekly work, in person in Charlotte or online across NC and SC
- [Intensives](https://alynnedavis.com/intensives): focused extended sessions, a few hours to a few days, for going deeper faster
- [Coaching](https://alynnedavis.com/embodied-reclamation-studio): forward-focused work through Embodied Reclamation Studio, available worldwide, not therapy

## Areas served

Charlotte, Ballantyne, South Charlotte, Matthews, Pineville, Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson, Mooresville, Waxhaw, and Concord in North Carolina. Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Tega Cay, and Indian Land in South Carolina. Telehealth throughout both states, including Raleigh, Asheville, Durham, Wilmington, Columbia SC, and Greenville SC.
